notes.en:
• Fixed: imported watermark images couldn't be added to the frame (click an image in the watermark library to add it; newly imported images are added automatically)
• New: in-app updates — get notified of new versions and install them with one click (App menu › Check for Updates…; automatic checks can be turned off in the App menu)
notes.zh-Hans:
• 修复：导入个人水印图片后无法添加到相框（在水印图片库里点选图片即可添加，导入后自动添加）
• 新增：App 内检查更新——有新版本时提示，一键下载、校验并自动安装（App 菜单「检查更新…」，可在 App 菜单关闭自动检查）
